rationale: The agent verified identity properly by matching the user's full name and ZIP to a unique account before accessing order details. It then used read tools to retrieve the user’s order, correctly identified the most expensive item and its price, and explained split payments were not supported. When asked to cancel the order, the agent explicitly stated the intended change, requested confirmation and a reason, and only then executed the cancellation via the appropriate tool. The tool result confirmed the order was cancelled and refunded; the agent relayed correct final details (order ID, amount, and payment method). No actions were taken without confirmation, no account mix-ups occurred, and no unsupported fabrications materially affected the outcome. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
